by combining the stochastic VAE framework with spatial information we are able to learn powerful image representations that can be used to generate high quality samples.

the VAE framework is a powerful tool for learning powerful global image features and that the combination of stochastic and autoregressive layers is not necessary to achieve high quality image generation.
